answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity to a storage duty: each epoch the network assigns random data shards that each identity must hold and serve. Auditors arrive as a whisper — surprise requests for random byte ranges answered within a tight deadline. A lone agent passes easily. A sybil farm cramming hundreds of puppets onto one rented machine chokes, its single pipe unable to serve them all in time. Misses decay the identity's standing, so the farmer must buy dedicated bandwidth per puppet, and the nectar of cheap multiplexed scale curdles into a per-seat cost.
